body.title: Complete budgeted controller design-review flows
body.summary: Integrate review-step MCP registration, state/types/host dispatch, template/extract start, claims/evidence, findings and verdicts with admitted complete frames, existing pipeline adapters, exact-set terminal checks and atomic owner recovery. Keep existing outer phase names while versioning continuation payloads.
acceptanceChecks: All actual controller emission sites (template, extraction, batched verification) use complete-frame inclusive admission and explicit controller-reserved profiles; no daemon-only implementation is advertised as all-review coverage.

Existing adapters preserve all source/claims/obligations across one-call-per-turn continuations; evidence gathering occurs only after complete extraction and finalization only after all required work validates.

Both terminal handlers decode callId/answer and enforce exact expected sets before persistence under the trusted atomic claim; missing declarations, stale tokens, replay and interrupted writes have the approved recovery behavior.
New registered MCP schemas and returned inner schemas agree with handlers and schema lookup; old clients/tokens receive explicit incompatibility/refusal rather than a silent budget bypass.
Template/grounded/full/degraded controller cases, dynamic host reserve and chunk time, cancellation, real two-worker duplicate submissions and cross-protocol resume mismatches are verified.

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/review-step/__tests__/budget-continuations.test.ts: template extraction evidence verification and finalization preserve every required claim through admitted controller turns
src/mcp/__tests__/review-budget-schema.test.ts: registered design-review phases validate declarations envelopes stale states and host-reserve qualification
